div.p: The Arc, a seed-funded new-media startup, has its finger on the pulse of India’s high-growth companies. It delivers sharp, objective and research-backed news reports and analysis that resonate with both general readers and corporate executives.We supported the redesign of The Arc’s platform, working closely with its founders and developers. A key area of focus was settling on a common design language, which served as the foundation for collaboration and faster results.

We built the MVP for The Arc, but as the product grew, so did the chaos. Features were shipping fast, but not always in sync. Designers, developers, and founders found themselves speaking slightly different design languages—which made decisions slower and development heavier than it needed to be.
There was a clear need for a shared foundation. Something that could bring consistency, reduce back-and-forth, and support the pace of growth.
